alice: Quick check — planning a staged rollout for client bindings v2.4. Minor API shape changes (optional headers). Deploy window tomorrow 09:00 PST. Who's on deploy and smoke?
ben: I can own deploy. I'll be on call from 08:30–10:30 PT. @carol you good for smoke?
carol: Yep. I'll run the smoke suite and verify SDK examples. Quick note: clients older than v2.2 will get a harmless 400 for the new header. Need comms?
dima: I can prepare the rollback playbook and a quick script to flip traffic weights. Putting it in ops repo. snippet: `./ops/flip_traffic --model sdk-bindings --from v2.4 --to v2.3 --env prod` — I'll open a PR.
ben: For smoke, plan: hit /generate with seq=32, sampling off, validate latency < 150ms p95 and no tokenization errors. I'll paste curl in thread when ready.
carol: Also will run end-to-end for webhooks. If we see any auth failures, rollback immediately.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by CI for 2025-06-12T16:00:00Z to canary group 5%. CI artifacts: build-2.4-20250612.
alice: Perfect. @ben please paste the curl tests. @dima link the rollback PR. I'll draft the partner comms and drop in #marketing for review.
ben: Curl: `curl -H "X-Client-Flags: new-binding" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` — smoke also checks that response includes "binding_version":"2.4".
carol: All set. I'll report back in this thread after canary. :thumbsup:
